cleared_source_contracts: MasterDetail reports actual effective draw bounds through existing LayoutFacts and reads them through FrameRead::layout; no terminal-width assumption or state-owned Rect cache remains.

The real detail descendants are wrapped in a Normal FocusRing scope. Cx::focused_in_scope uses actual registered focus, transitive scope ancestry and current top-layer eligibility. No invisible block control or ID-prefix membership inference is introduced.
Leaf dispatch precedes scoped binding dispatch. The actual public CodeEditor consumer consumes its first Escape; a later Escape closes the drawer. Top modal and sibling focus do not close the drawer.
Scoped bindings use existing Binding descriptors, key remapping, frame storage and runtime callback dispatch. There is no second input engine or effectful measurement.

The new bounds/scope fix does not add application data, route names or replay selectors to the library. The merged right-alignment change in runtime/ui/mod.rs is an external source change; this packet does not establish its full independent acceptance.

remaining_finding.problem: After a scoped binding is selected, its update result is not checked before the else-if chain skips global Bubble and default Escape handling. An ignored scoped action therefore swallows the key. Nested outer scopes are not attempted if the deepest scope declines either.
remaining_finding.observed: A real focused Button declines Escape, a published scoped binding is routed to its owner and returns ignored, but App::on_esc is never invoked: counter 0 instead of 1.
remaining_finding.required_fix: Dispatch eligible scoped candidates from deepest to outer scope, checking consumed after each, then preserve the pre-existing global Bubble/default Escape path if none consumes. Reuse existing owner binding intents and callback lifecycle. Do not forward raw copied keys, drain unrelated owner buckets or introduce application routing.
required_regressions: A declined inner scoped binding falls through to a consuming outer scoped binding.
If all scoped bindings decline, global Bubble or App::on_esc runs exactly once.
A consumed leaf or scope stops propagation; top modal, unrelated popup and sibling scopes remain isolated.

summary_probe_correction.preserved_test: summary_rows_reserves_requested_clamped_height remains unchanged and red in the original probe file/log.
summary_probe_correction.cause: The assertion expects Runtime::area_of(MASTER).height to equal the complete master allocation. The actual master is CodeEditor::fill_height; CodeEditor::draw reserves one footer row and registers only the body, so area_of returns 7 for an 8-row allocation.
summary_probe_correction.replacement_evidence: A separate probe summary_layout_reserves_three_rows_plus_gap_and_editor_footer passes: summary starts at y=9 and registered master body height 7 plus its one-row footer equals the expected 8-row master allocation. The native consumer checks summary positions at multiple heights.
summary_probe_correction.interpretation: This particular remaining red is a probe interpretation defect, not evidence that the summary sizing fix failed. The original output and assertion were not silently blessed or removed.
